movie.title: Hayagrriva
movie.overview: Hayagrriva is a gritty medical thriller following detective Arjun as he investigates a string of bizarre murders featuring animal-hybrid victims. As public panic climbs, he must track down a brilliant, mythologically obsessed psychopath using advanced surgical science to play God, while desperately trying to save his own family.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a series of gruesome murders involving animal-hybrid victims terrifies the city, Detective Arjun must race against time to stop a mythologically obsessed doctor playing God.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Detective Arjun is assigned to lead the investigation into a string of horrific murders featuring victims surgically combined with animal parts. As public panic mounts, Arjun discovers the killer is a brilliant, unhinged surgeon who draws inspiration from ancient mythology to perform monstrous experiments. The case turns deeply personal when the doctor turns his sights toward Arjun's own family. To protect the ones he loves, Arjun must unravel the mastermind's twisted philosophy and put an end to his terrifying reign.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Hayagrriva follows Detective Arjun, a seasoned investigator called in when a shocking crime scene exposes a victim surgically altered with animal traits. As more bodies surface, each bearing intricate and horrific biological modifications, the city plunges into widespread terror. Arjun teams up with medical experts to decipher the perpetrator's methods, quickly realizing they are dealing with a rogue surgical genius. The killer's motives stem from a deeply distorted obsession with mythology, viewing his gruesome experiments as a way to transcend human limitations and play God. As Arjun closes in on the culprit's hideout, the killer retaliates by targeting Arjun's wife and child, turning the investigation into a desperate rescue mission. Outmaneuvering the police at every turn, the antagonist uses advanced medical technology to create deadly traps and psychological games. Arjun is forced to navigate dark, subterranean laboratories and face terrifying biological horrors to reach his family in time. In a pulse-pounding final confrontation, Arjun relies on sheer willpower and tactical grit to neutralize the surgeon before his ultimate experiment is realized.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Hayagrriva is a high-stakes, gritty medical thriller that merges dark police procedural elements with shocking scientific horror. The story centers on Detective Arjun, a dedicated officer taskforce leader thrust into the darkest case of his career when a series of bizarre murders grip the city. Each crime scene reveals victims who have been brutally modified with animal features using highly advanced, near-impossible surgical techniques. As chaos spreads and the media drives public panic to a fever pitch, Arjun uncovers a terrifying pattern connecting the killer's methods to ancient mythological concepts. The adversary is not a mere murderer, but a brilliant, mythologically obsessed psychopath obsessed with reshaping humanity. When the killer singles out Arjun's family to serve as the ultimate subjects for his twisted vision, Arjun must push beyond his physical and emotional limits to bring down a madman playing God.

story_structure.risingAction: As public panic escalates, Arjun digs deeper into complex medical trails and ancient mythic clues, racing against time while the killer's traps hit dangerously close to home.
